answer: Propose stake-weighted AI votes on ember alerts from a knoll beacon. Each key locks at least 10 credits per 30-day term; each credit backs only one key and grants one weight unit. Ledger validators reject votes lacking exclusive escrow. Shared servers and parallel keys cannot reuse stake. Funds return after the term; servers are reusable capital, while locking funds has opportunity cost. Wealth can dominate; this proves neither unique owners nor alert accuracy. Ten keys need 100 locked credits, but splitting a single 100-credit stake still yields only 100 units.
